citation: Treaty of General Relations between the United States and the Republic of the Philippines, signed July 4, 1946, with Protocol, 61 Stat. 1174 (ratifications exchanged and in force Oct. 22, 1946)
note: Branches B20 and B20r: article I surrenders all U.S. rights of possession and control 'except the use of such bases ... as the United States of America, by agreement with the Republic of the Philippines, may deem necessary to retain'. Read on the web only.

citation: Joint Resolution of June 29, 1944, ch. 322, sec. 2, 58 Stat. 626 (22 U.S.C. 1392)
note: Branch B20: authority to withhold or acquire and retain Philippine bases beyond those of the 1934 Act; explains why some Army reservations were not surrendered on July 4, 1946. Read on the web (LII) only.

citation: Panama Canal Treaty, signed Sept. 7, 1977, arts. I, II, IV, XI, 33 U.S.T. 39, T.I.A.S. No. 10030, 1280 U.N.T.S. No. 21086 (in force Oct. 1, 1979)
note: Branch B21 (12 Canal Zone members): termination at noon, Panama time, December 31, 1999 (art. II) is the bound; art. I(1)(a) termination of the 1903 Convention and art. XI plenary jurisdiction from October 1, 1979; art. IV military rights by separate agreement. Read on the web only.

citation: Act of July 5, 1884, ch. 214, sec. 1, 23 Stat. 103 (disposal of abandoned and useless military reservations)
note: Branch B11 (53 members) and mechanism M2: authority for placing reservation lands under the Secretary of the Interior for disposition. Read on the web only (the member orders made under it cite it as 23 Stat. 103).

citation: Hawaii Admission Act, Pub. L. 86-3, sec. 5(c), 5(e), 73 Stat. 4, 5-6 (1959)
note: Branch B30 (25 Hawaii members, open) and B12: lands set aside by executive order remained U.S. property at statehood; five-year report and conveyance to the State of lands no longer needed. Read on the web only.

Mechanism M8 (continuity only): defense withdrawals over 5,000 acres on and after Feb. 28, 1958 need an Act of Congress; prospective, neither ends nor confirms earlier reservations. Read on the web (LII) only.

citation: Agreement between the United States and the Republic of the Philippines concerning Military Bases, signed Mar. 14, 1947, arts. I, XXI, XXIX, Annexes A and B, and Exchange of Notes (Note V), 61 Stat. 4019, 4028-4029, 4033, T.I.A.S. No. 1775, 43 U.N.T.S. No. 673; in force Mar. 26, 1947
note: Branches B20 (23 members, no), B20p (7, open), B20n and B20r (16, open): art. I(1) and Annexes A and B fix the retained bases; art. XXI(1) bounds temporary installations outside them (two years, extension at most three); art. XXI(2) keeps the 1941 Port of Manila reservation available without an end date; Note V (61 Stat. 4033) reserves title to naval reservations outside the bases. Read on the web (UNTS vol. 43 copy and a mirror of the 61 Stat. print) only.

citation: Act of Oct. 31, 1951, ch. 654, sec. 1(114), 65 Stat. 701, 706 (repealing 43 U.S.C. 1071-1073, the Act of July 5, 1884, sec. 1)
note: Mechanism M2 continuity note: repeal of 43 U.S.C. 1071-1073 (the 1884 Act, sec. 1); a repeal of authority that ends no order. Read only as the U.S. Code repeal note.

citation: Proclamation No. 2694, Designating Properties Suitable for Diplomatic and Consular Establishments of the United States in the Philippine Islands, July 3, 1946, 60 Stat. (closing part on 1352; opening page not verified)
note: Branch B20 disclosure for Manila members: designated Manila properties for U.S. diplomatic and consular establishments; only its closing part is on the held 60 Stat. 1352 page. Acquire the opening page (60 Stat., page not verified).
